hero.name: Rian Moraes
hero.lede: Today I lead IntelliFix, an Industry 4.0 platform at SMI. From front-end to deploy — through IoT, real-time data, and command-line tooling.

projects.label: Selected work
projects.title: Projects
projects.intro: A selection of what I've built — products in production, tools, and real systems. Click for details.

intellifix.title: IntelliFix
intellifix.description: Industrial platform that optimizes maintenance and production with IoT, real-time data, and predictive analysis. As technical lead, I drive the architecture and full-stack development of the product — now used by global companies in the industrial sector.
methods: Predictive analysis algorithms over equipment data
benefits: Cuts operating costs through predictive maintenance
Increases efficiency and productivity of operations
results: Led from scratch as technical lead
Real digital transformation of industrial processes

gapizer.title: Gapizer
gapizer.description: A Go command-line tool that generates complete APIs from a single YAML file: project structure, routes, handlers, middlewares (auth and logging), Swagger docs, and more. Speed without giving up consistency.
benefits: Dramatically speeds up the start of an API project
Removes the repetitive setup of each project
results: Open source, built to learn Go in depth
Hands-on demonstration of Go and CLI building

culturaconnect.title: Cultura Connect
culturaconnect.description: Platform for managing and promoting cultural projects in Brazil. Connects artists, producers, companies, and sponsors in a collaborative ecosystem, with modern cultural-management tooling.
methods: Connection system between artists and sponsors
benefits: Puts professional management within a creator's reach
results: Complete platform for cultural project management

razaoquest.title: Razão Quest
razaoquest.description: A mobile app that turns the school routine into a game: students earn coins and XP by completing missions, redeem them in the in-app store, and teachers reward or penalize based on performance. Access via QR Code.
methods: Gamification system with coins and XP
Integration with the existing school system
benefits: Gives the school visibility into progress
Makes the educational experience more active
results: In production at a school with 200+ students
Fully integrated into the school environment

razaoquestadmin.title: Razão Quest Admin
razaoquestadmin.description: The panel where coordinators and teachers manage the whole gamification platform: mission setup, products and rewards, inventory control, bonus attribution, and progress tracking.
methods: Full integration with the mobile app
benefits: Total control over the gamification experience
Efficient management of rewards and progress
results: Essential tool for managing the gamification

pdrlelo.title: PDR & Lelo
pdrlelo.description: Conversion-focused landing page for PDR & Lelo, a disposables company in Rio de Janeiro. Built in Next.js with GSAP animations and technical SEO to turn visitors into customers.
benefits: Optimizes the visitor's path to contact
results: Professional landing page delivered and live
Smooth GSAP animations lifting the experience

digitalfactory.title: Digital Factory
digitalfactory.description: A digital-factory system for Industry 4.0 with full IIoT simulation, real-time data processing, and analytics. Distributed architecture with .NET microservices, a React dashboard, and TimescaleDB for massive sensor-data streams.
methods: Sensor-data ingestion through an MQTT broker
results: Real-time processing of thousands of sensor points
Full dashboard with OEE and KPIs

marianafisio.title: Home-Care Physiotherapy
marianafisio.description: Institutional landing page for patient acquisition via WhatsApp, with local content, social proof, and technical SEO. Mobile-first and fast.
methods: Local intent research and service keyword mapping
Human-centered copy focused on clarity and trust
Persistent CTA for fast WhatsApp contact
benefits: Clearer value proposition for local audiences
Stronger visual trust through social proof
results: Professional digital presence for the service
Solid base for local traffic campaigns

lumiris.title: Lumiris
lumiris.description: A patient-records SaaS for occupational therapists. CREFITO-standard structured anamnesis, audio evolution that AI transcribes and organizes, and a quarterly report generated automatically for the health plan — without losing clinical rigor. Fully LGPD-compliant.
methods: CREFITO-standard structured anamnesis, exportable to PDF
Audio evolution with AI transcription and organization
Automatic quarterly report cross-referencing evolutions and goals
Built with Next.js + Drizzle, focused on LGPD and security
benefits: Quarterly report: from 2-3 hours to ~20 minutes
Complete records in one place — no Word, notebook, or WhatsApp
Encrypted data, on servers in Brazil
results: Own SaaS in production, from concept to deploy
Free, Student, and Pro plans live

lumia.title: Lumia Acessórios
lumia.description: Semi-fine jewelry store on Nuvemshop, with a category-based catalog and a mobile-first buying journey. Theme customization, product showcasing, and sales SEO.
methods: Theme customization and category catalog on Nuvemshop

bassani.title: Bassani Filmmaker
bassani.description: Landing page for a photographer and filmmaker, focused on showcasing the visual portfolio and converting to contact. Clean visuals, scroll rhythm, and fast loading.
methods: Structure oriented to a visual portfolio
benefits: Full spotlight on the visual work

cassinovegas.title: Cassino Vegas
cassinovegas.description: Online casino (iGaming) platform with a game catalog, user area, and real-time operations. Focused on performance and a smooth experience under load.

blackpearl.title: Black Pearl Broker
blackpearl.description: IQ Option-style trading platform: real-time charts, trade execution, and an investor area. Live data and an interface built for speed.

smi.description: I lead the technical development of the IntelliFix platform: new features, architecture, and performance. I joined as a junior, became a full-stack mid-level dev in two months, and reached technical lead in under a year, serving large global industrial companies.
achievements: From junior to technical lead in under 1 year
Technical leadership of the dev team
Mentoring and technical reference for the team

faciltel.description: I joined as the sole front-end dev on a legacy Angular.js system — inconsistent layout, poor performance. After a technical review, I proposed and executed a full refactor to Next.js 14, modernizing the whole front-end architecture.
achievements: Full refactor from Angular.js to Next.js 14
International expansion: global SIM and eSIM sales
Major gains in performance and scale

direcao.description: I built web experiences focused on Next.js and SEO, and occasionally worked on the back-end — which broadened my full-stack view.

about.label: About
about.title: About
about.p1: I'm a full-stack developer. I started coding in 2020 and, at SMI, went from junior to technical lead in under a year — today I drive the development of IntelliFix, an Industry 4.0 platform used by global companies.
about.p2: I like hard problems: real-time data, factory-floor integration, refactoring legacy, command-line tooling. I write from front-end to deploy, and I care about what happens after the code ships — performance, maintenance, and the next dev who'll touch it.
